name: Kisagi Ruuruu
source:
"Yay, a corpse! Ru looooves corpses~!"

One of two twin 'sisters' from the Kizaki clan, whose duties are to oversee the Hanamukenogi ceremony. A girl who 'loves' everything in the world, who can always be seen with a smile on her face. She and her younger sister, [url=https://vndb.org/c166557]Mimi[/url], were born as two halves of a whole, with Ruru being in possession of all that has to do with 'love'.

Flower: Alstroemeria
Bloom Factor: [???]
Magic: [Suikesshou] — Absorb surrounding heat.

[Translated by the [url=https://Acacia.wiki.gg/Ruru_Kizaki]Acacia Wiki[/url].]
[Description taken from the [url=https://https://mahoumura.com/]Official Site[/url].]
